<!--

===============================================================================

SAM Framework

Knowledge Document Template

===============================================================================



Purpose

-------

Use this template to document validated operational or architectural knowledge.



A Knowledge document answers:



"What do we know to be true?"



Knowledge represents verified understanding.



It should be stable enough to serve as a trusted reference.



Knowledge is not:



\- Research notes

\- Incident reports

\- Meeting minutes

\- Personal opinions

\- Temporary observations



See:



\- KNOWLEDGE\_MODEL.md (future)

\- RESEARCH\_TEMPLATE.md

\- INCIDENT\_TEMPLATE.md

\- PLAYBOOK\_TEMPLATE.md

\- TRUST\_MODEL.md



===============================================================================

\-->

<!--

Author Checklist

----------------

\-->



# Author Checklist



\- \[ ] Knowledge statement is objective

\- \[ ] Evidence documented

\- \[ ] Trust level considered

\- \[ ] Scope defined

\- \[ ] Limitations documented

\- \[ ] Applicability documented

\- \[ ] Cross references validated

\- \[ ] Consistent with GLOSSARY.md



---



<!--

Common Mistakes

---------------

\-->



# Common Mistakes



\- Recording opinions as knowledge.

\- Copying vendor documentation without validation.

\- Omitting evidence.

\- Ignoring limitations.

\- Mixing research with verified knowledge.

\- Treating assumptions as facts.

\- Failing to define applicability.



---



<!--

Completion Checklist

--------------------

\-->



# Completion Checklist



\- \[ ] Metadata complete

\- \[ ] Evidence reviewed

\- \[ ] Cross references verified

\- \[ ] Review completed

\- \[ ] Ready for publication



---



# Summary



Summarize the verified knowledge.



State:



\- what is known,

\- why it is trusted,

\- where it applies,

\- and how it should be used.
